DET190910140.title: Pirates at Tigers
DET190910140.intro: 1909 World Series · Game 6. Tigers lead 5-3 going to the ninth. Pirates lead 3-2. Tigers facing elimination.

history.t: Wilson lays down a sacrifice bunt; Miller scores.
Gibson reaches on a fielder's choice.
Abbaticchio strikes out swinging; Wilson is caught stealing third.

DET190810100.intro: 1908 World Series · Game 1. Tigers lead 6-5 going to the ninth. Series opener.
